root_policy: A rootlp phase label only proves stage entry; require an explicit completion receipt or a later solver phase before claiming root LP completed. Missing callbacks mean unobserved, not proof that no internal work occurred.
bound_policy: Check finite value, source/timestamp/objective identity and consistency with a verified feasible objective; conflicting bounds are invalid. Native-only bounds are solver-reported, not exact certificates. Do not use the full physical energy interval as a MILP objective certificate without accounting for their relationship.
stop_rule: One claimed slot, one request at most; no retry even on no-call failure; no OFF or ABC launch.
deadline_policy: Parent origin before configuration/imports; all method work charged. Final publication requires 240+10+50 remaining. Solver/response cutoff 370; full physical evaluation cutoff 420; no late credit.
watchdog_policy: At parent+500 terminate only recorded owned identities; wait_procs timeout10. Watchdog is a threshold, not a hard total wall bound. Report cleanup and full controller wall; no scientific credit during cleanup.
bound_scope: Numerical consistency against admitted saved/returned MILP objective only; no independently certified lower bound is produced by this adapter.
decision_policy: One slot/request at most; stop without retry on any outcome. Root-LP completion, bound above box lower bound or new SAFE are separate progress observations; not pruning speedup.
approval_policy: Separate explicit user approval must bind this plan hash. The plan, tests, screenshot, commit and approval template do not authorize a run. Software guards are not a cryptographic identity or OS security boundary.
